hook: A Craftsman house the carpenter Arthur Simpson built for himself, 1934.

building.completed_conflict: The survey's building record dates the house to June 1934; its own inventory form and the assessor's roll both give 1935.

historic_survey.finding: Appears ineligible for the California Register and the National Register — unconnected to the families of the boat-building industry and not architecturally significant — but one of the older dwellings in the neighbourhood, of high integrity, and warranting special consideration in local planning
historic_survey.note: A one-story-over-garage clapboard house set back toward the middle of its lot behind a raised concrete retaining wall, with a shallow side-facing gable and a gable-roofed porch. The survey names no architect.

historical_record.description: The original permit describes a one-story frame building costing $1,500, built by a carpenter as a house for himself and his wife.
